method: Independent synthetic SQLite input with valid public records, wrong domain/source records, pre-cutoff traffic, private tables and sentinel secrets in omitted fields.
limits: Checks export selection and database read-only handling, not completeness of a real server snapshot.
Retained values from trusted whitelisted public-source facts remain data; the export is not a general-purpose content redaction tool.
An output file is written locally as requested; no server was contacted.
